appraisals.text: The keeper has performed the duties of the post during the year under review. Attendance and conduct have been satisfactory. Station duties have been carried out in accordance with standing instructions. No matters arise for the attention of the District Office.
switchgear work well handled this year. Closed.

Eimhin at Dunsaille Head, 2013. Settled in and got on with things. I have a concern about the distribution side that I do not want to overstate but will not leave unsaid. Fitted in well with the station party. A pleasure to have on the station. switchgear work is where they shine. A thoroughly decent keeper.

Mac Neidhe at Dunsaille Head. The thing I would put on record about Eimhin is the batteries. Nobody asked him to be good at it. I have a concern about pumped systems that I do not want to overstate but will not leave unsaid. That is the measure of the keeper.
Knows more about the standby banks than the engineers do. Will not touch pumped systems if he can get someone else to do it. Enough said.
Old school. the standby banks done properly and no shortcuts. the pumps has to be checked behind him. That is the plain truth of it. That is all.
Mac Neidhe. Nothing to report and that suits me. the pumps has to be checked behind him. That is the plain truth of it. Enough said.
Mac Neidhe. the control side of the sets has to be checked behind him. That is the plain truth of it. Enough said.
the distribution side has to be checked behind him. That is the plain truth of it. Enough said.

Mac Neidhe. the distribution side has to be checked behind him. That is the plain truth of it. Not much to say. the changeover gear is sound and that is the main thing. Attended the district course in the changeover gear, though I am told the paperwork never came back. That is all.
Report of the Superintendent, Errisbeg Bay. This report should be read alongside the station return for the same period. Submitted for consideration.

I have thought about how to write this one. There is a habit of mind here that is worth writing down: Eimhin will not leave the panels half done. Over the year Eimhin has quietly become the station's go-to for the pumps. I have a concern about switchgear work that I do not want to overstate but will not leave unsaid. The thing I would put on record about Eimhin is the changeover gear. Nobody asked him to be good at it. That is the whole of it.
